ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Persistence Via Microsoft Office Add-In
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential persistence activity via startup add-ins that load when Microsoft Office starts (.wll/.xll are simply .dll fit for Word or Excel).

sequences.query: ((file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Word\\\\Startup\\\\.*") AND file_path = RGX("\\\.wll$")) OR (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Excel\\\\Startup\\\\.*") AND file_path = RGX("\\\.xll$")) OR (file_path = RGX(".*Microsoft\\\\Excel\\\\XLSTART\\\\.*") AND file_path = RGX("\\\.xlam$")) OR (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Addins\\\\.*") AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.xlam$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.xla$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.ppam$"))))
